item.title: Jensen Beach Park restrooms and Sea Turtle Beach Cafe rebuild expected by late 2027
item.description: Beachgoers at Jensen Beach Park are waiting for the rebuild of restrooms and a concession building destroyed in a fire on New Year's Eve in December 2024. The county says final funding is expected to be approved in September.

item.title: St. Lucie County offers free rip current safety training at three pools this summer
item.description: St. Lucie County Parks & Recreation is hosting three free rip current safety demonstrations using a new simulation machine at local public pools. The training teaches proper escape techniques in a controlled environment.

item.title: Vero Beach condo owner says waste management fees nearly doubled under new county contract
item.description: Thomas Clark told WPTV his monthly condo association waste management fees jumped from $11 to $21 in Vero Beach. Indian River County officials say the increase stems from a new contract with Waste Management that began in October 2025.

item.title: Lionel Messi leads Argentina to 3-2 comeback over Egypt to reach World Cup quarterfinals
item.description: Argentina rallied from a 2-0 deficit in the final 11 minutes to defeat Egypt 3-2 on Tuesday, with Lionel Messi scoring his eighth goal of the tournament.

item.title: United States eliminated from World Cup in 4-1 loss to Belgium
item.description: The United States hopes for a deep World Cup run at home ended when Belgium defeated the Americans 4-1 on Monday night in Seattle.

item.title: US-Belgium World Cup match draws record 30 million viewers on Fox
item.description: Monday's United States-Belgium World Cup match was the most-watched soccer telecast in U.S. history, Fox Sports reported.

item.title: IOC ends neutral status vetting for Russian athletes ahead of 2028 LA Olympics
item.description: The IOC advised Olympic sports bodies on Tuesday to end a three-year program vetting Russians for neutral status ahead of qualifying events for the 2028 Los Angeles Olympics.
